title: One Journey, With Side Quests Built In
changes: Lessons and side-quest activities that go shakily (under 75% accuracy, with a real sample of answers) are now automatically repeated — up to two extra tries — before the journey advances, instead of moving on regardless.
A repeated topic lesson reuses the exact same words as the attempt that needed another pass, so it's genuinely the same lesson again, not a new pick of words.
Activity landmarks now clearly explain that they join your main journey automatically as side quests when you're ready — no separate browsing or unlocking needed.
The old 'Activity Skills' grid is now a collapsed, clearly optional 'Free practice' section for extra reps outside your main path, instead of sitting alongside it as an equal, separate choice.
A new 'Your journey ahead' list on the Journey screen shows the upcoming topics in order, alongside the existing 'Learning history' timeline of where you've already been.
